Definition: sculpture (in low or high relief or even intaglio)
BiblicalUsage: Pittuach is engraving, carving in stone or wood. The gold plate of the high priest's crown was engraved HOLINESS TO THE LORD in Exodus 28:36, and Solomon's temple walls were carved with cherubim and palm trees in 1 Kings 6:29. God promises in Zechariah 3:9 to engrave the graving of the stone He laid before Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God writes His name on His people the way an engraver writes on gold — it does not wash off.
